set_up.summary: This project can be run using Docker Compose configurations for development, local, staging, or production environments, or via Makefile targets and manual setup with Poetery and Python.

env_vars.name: ENVIRONMENT
env_vars.purpose: Sets the application environment (DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, PRODUCTION) to configure log levels and behavior.

env_vars.name: REDIS_PORT
env_vars.purpose: Overrides the default Redis port (6379) for local or isolated development.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_USER
env_vars.purpose: Specifies the PostgreSQL username for database authentication (default: user).

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env_vars.purpose: Specifies the PostgreSQL password for database authentication (default: password).

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_DB
env_vars.purpose: Specifies the PostgreSQL database name (default: dbname).

env_vars.name: WORKERS
env_vars.purpose: Overrides the number of Uvicorn/Gunicorn workers (default: 4).

env_vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
env_vars.purpose: Explicitly sets the application log level, overriding the default based on ENVIRONMENT.

files_guide.purpose: Production-grade compose file with optimized build target 'production', no reload, and worker concurrency set.
Development compose file with code volumes, reload enabled, and explicit paths to app folders for FastAPI development.
Local development alternative using single context root with Dockerfile in ./docker and source mounted directly from project root.
Staging environment compose file, identical to dev but uses environment variables from .env files for staging-specific configs.
Multi-stage Dockerfile for building API-main; contains base, dependencies, development, and production stages.
Dockerfile for Celery worker and beat services, focused on Python and Celery dependencies with SQS and AWS support.
Gunicorn configuration file used in production mode to manage Uvicorn workers, logging, and process behavior.
Configuration file for database migrations using Alembic, pointing to the migrations/ directory.
Task runner with aliases for installing dependencies, running tests, linting, formatting, and running the API locally.
Script to verify system dependencies (Docker, Node.js, Python 3.11+, AWS CLI) before running the project.
Main Nginx server configuration for production, includes rate limiting, gzip, SSL, and security headers.
Nginx site configuration for routing traffic to backend services (api-main, web-dashboard, pwa-display-app) and enforcing HTTPS.
Entry point script that loads .env, normalizes ENVIRONMENT, verifies Python packages, and starts Uvicorn or Gunicorn.

run_options.name: Docker Compose (all services)
run_options.best_for: Consistent, isolated development, staging, or production environments with full stack in containers.

steps.title: Ensure Docker is running
steps.description: Verify Docker daemon is active.

steps.title: Build and start services in development mode
steps.description: Use dev compose file with code volumes for live reloading during development.

steps.title: Build and start services in local mode
steps.description: Use local compose file with project root mounted, ideal for Python devs with local virtual environments.

steps.title: Build and start services in staging mode
steps.description: Use staging compose file with environment variables from .env for non-prod deployments.

steps.title: Build and start services in production mode
steps.description: Use production compose file with optimized images, no reload, and Gunicorn workers.

steps.title: Verify services are healthy
steps.description: Check that PostgreSQL and Redis are ready, then access API at localhost:8000/docs.
steps.command: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f api-main && sleep 5 && curl http://localhost:8000/docs

run_options.name: Makefile (local development)
run_options.best_for: Quick local testing without Docker, when Python 3.11+ and dependencies are already installed.

steps.title: Install project dependencies
steps.description: Install all Python dependencies using Poetry (dev and main).

steps.title: Set environment variables
steps.description: Copy .env.example to .env and set required variables.

steps.title: Run database migrations
steps.description: Apply Alembic migrations to initialize the database schema.

steps.title: Start the API server
steps.description: Launch FastAPI with Uvicorn in development mode with auto-reload.

steps.title: Start Celery worker
steps.description: Run the Celery worker in background for async tasks.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app worker -l INFO --queues=s3-events,default,celery

steps.title: Start Celery beat scheduler
steps.description: Run the Celery beat scheduler for periodic tasks.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app beat -l INFO

run_options.name: Manual local setup (Python + Poetry)
run_options.best_for: Debugging dependencies or running in non-standard environments where Docker/Makefile cannot be used.

steps.title: Install Poetry if not present
steps.description: Install Poetry using the official installer.

steps.title: Clone and navigate to project
steps.description: Ensure you are in the project root directory.

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.description: Install all packages from poetry.lock.

steps.title: Set environment variables
steps.description: Create .env file with minimum required values.

steps.title: Run database migrations
steps.description: Apply Alembic migrations to setup tables.

steps.title: Start FastAPI server
steps.description: Run Uvicorn directly with specified module and reload.

steps.title: Start Celery worker
steps.description: Start worker process for background tasks.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app worker -l INFO --queues=s3-events,default,celery

steps.title: Start Celery beat
steps.description: Start periodic task scheduler.
steps.command: poetry run celery -A src.core.celery_app:app beat -l INFO
